text:
maria: quick alignment needed — Beacon customer privacy rollout. we have a hard customer request to support per-tenant pii redaction + private model variant for 1.0. need sequencing across product/eng/runtime/infra/security by EOW. can teams confirm constraints?

ajay: ack. what are the concrete blockers from product?

maria: main asks: (1) per-tenant redaction pipeline that strips names/emails from logs/metrics, (2) private model variant (quantized) for tenant data residency, (3) canary strategy + launch criteria.

zane: runtime note: private variant will need a compatible KV-cache format and quantization profile. we can support 4-bit quant (q4_0) but p95 latency will rise ~15% unless we tweak kernels. need 2 weeks to validate perf on staging.

linda: infra: reserved GPU pool for private tenants is fine but need exact GPU-hours estimate. also network isolation requires VPC endpoint + NAT config — ops will need a week after specs.

kevin: security: two things — threat model + dataflow for redaction, and a compliance sign-off for private variant (KMS/HSM integration). schedule security review by Thu or later. also need retention policy spelled out.

maria: proposed launch criteria (draft):
- canary on 10% of tenant traffic for 48h
- perf: p95 latency <250ms (token gen path)
- errors <0.5% and no data leakage incidents
- cost delta <20% for tenant monthly bill

ajay: numbers feel tight given zane's perf delta. can we allow p95 up to 300ms if error and leakage guardrails hold?

zane: yes, we can aim for 300ms p95 as long as we enable prefix caching and reduce batch sizes to 1 for private lanes. will show microbenchmarks in 48h.

linda: GPU-hours: rough calc for 100 active sessions -> ~240 GPU-hours/week on A100. if quantized and smaller batch, that drops ~30%. need final model size to confirm.

kevin: for redaction, we need a test harness with labeled PII examples and a regression suite. security will own the harness but need product to provide canonical prompt+labels.
maria: I can put together a small prompt set from Beacon customer and anonymize it.

ajay: owners + deadlines?
maria: owners: product = maria (spec + prompt set) due Tue EOD, eng (platform) = ajay (integration + infra hooks) due next Fri, runtime = zane (quant/bench) due Wed, infra = linda (GPU reservation + VPC) due Fri, security = kevin (review + harness) due Thu.

kevin: noted. will we need a separate compliance package for customer legal?
maria: yes — patch for contract ops will go to legal; I'll create the ticket.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window requested by maria — tentative window 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. :calendar:

ajay: quick ask — can someone confirm rollback plan?
zane: rollback = route private tenant to hosted default model variant + clear KV cache. plan and runbook in `runbooks/beacon-private-rollback.md`.
linda: infra will set automated capacity reduction if error >1% for 10m.
maria: ok final ask: each owner, please drop a 1-line status in this thread by EOD today. I'll consolidate and send to the customer tomorrow. thanks :thumbsup:

ajay: will do.
zane: on it (benchmarks by tomorrow).
linda: reserve request posted.
kevin: review scheduled Thu 10am.
